messages:
incident-bot: [P0] Multiple inference-runtime pods crashlooping with SIGSEGV on ap-southeast-1. Automated pager: https://pagerduty.example/PD20024 :rotating_light:

maya_oncall: taking it. @jon_sre please assist. Any initial indicators of cause?

jon_sre: looking at kube events — 8 pods CrashLoopBackOff across 4 nodes, ExitCode 139. dmesg shows GPU reset and 'NVRM: Xid 13: Invalid Engine' messages. Container logs show segfaults inside custom_kernels.so.

eli_runtime: pulling the runtime logs now. Repeating stacktrace: `custom_kernels::optimized_conv::run()+0x9c` then SIGSEGV at 0x7fef.. Sometimes preceded by `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION`. This rolled out with runtime image v2.12-canary earlier this morning.

sophia_ml: customer impact: 3 enterprise clusters on dedicated pools report >80% failures; public latency for gen endpoints increased 4x. CS looped in.

nina_cs: I've messaged affected accounts and offered mitigations. They asked for ETA and whether we can failover them to stable nodes.

maya_oncall: can we failover traffic to stable pool while we mitigate?

jon_sre: yes, routing can move traffic. But immediate action: disable optimized kernels via runtime feature flag to stop hitting the faulty path. We have RUNTIME_FEATURE_OPTIMIZATIONS=false available. I can patch the statefulset.

eli_runtime: agree on flag flip. Also recommend we collect core dumps from one crashed container for postmortem before it restarts. I'll enable core_pattern and copy coredump to s3.

(maya_oncall posts command block)
```
$ kubectl set env statefulset/inference-runtime RUNTIME_FEATURE_OPTIMIZATIONS=false -n prod
statefulset.apps/inference-runtime env updated
$ kubectl rollout restart statefulset/inference-runtime -n prod
statefulset "inference-runtime" restarted
```

jon_sre: setting up coredump capture on node gpu-ap-03 and attaching socat to stream dump to s3. Also cordoning gpu-ap-07 which had repeated driver resets.

(jon_sre posts command block)
```
# enable core dumps on node
$ ssh root@gpu-ap-03 "sysctl -w kernel.core_pattern=/var/crash/core.%e.%p && echo core > /proc/sys/kernel/core_uses_pid"
# copy core to s3 once created (example)
$ scp root@gpu-ap-03:/var/crash/core.inference-runtime.1234 s3://redwood-incident-dumps/2002468102/
```

(log snippet)
```
2026-03-15T11:03:42Z inference-runtime | ERROR custom_kernels: segfault at 0x7fef3a2d
2026-03-15T11:03:42Z inference-runtime | ERROR loader: model load failed: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION
2026-03-15T11:03:43Z kernel: NVRM: Xid 13: Host Engine 00000000 Faulted
```

eli_runtime: after the env flip and restart, I see fallback to generic kernels in the logs. Models start loading again without segfaults.

(log snippet)
```
2026-03-15T11:07:01Z inference-runtime | WARN custom_kernels: optimizations disabled via env
2026-03-15T11:07:02Z inference-runtime | INFO model-loader: model llama-2 loaded in 1.1s
2026-03-15T11:07:03Z inference-runtime | INFO http: request 200 OK
```

sophia_ml: metrics: error rate on affected endpoints dropped from 42% -> 3% within 5 minutes. Dedicated customers report recovery.

nina_cs: customer comms updated. They're asking when the optimized kernels will be safe to re-enable.

maya_oncall: containment achieved. Next steps: roll back the canary image in prod to v2.11-stable, cordon noisy nodes, collect coredumps & debug, and open a rollback/patch PR. Eli, can you take lead on the runtime debugging? Jon will handle infra/node isolation.

eli_runtime: on it. I already grabbed the coredump and uploaded to s3: s3://redwood-incident-dumps/2002468102/core.inference-runtime.1234. Starting a gdb analysis and will run it under our debug image with symbols.

jon_sre: cordoning gpu-ap-07 and gpu-ap-03. Running drain for non-critical pods, will keep one diagnostic pod to capture dmesg and persist logs.

(infra_team posts command output)
```
$ kubectl cordon gpu-ap-07
node/gpu-ap-07 cordoned
$ kubectl drain gpu-ap-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
evicting pod inference-runtime-xxxxx
```

eli_runtime: preliminary gdb backtrace indicates null deref inside an allocator fastpath that the new fused conv uses. Suspect bad assumptions when running on certain driver versions (nvidia driver 535.XX shows different alignment). I'll open a hotfix branch to revert the fused conv change and add bounds checks.

maya_oncall: deploy-bot, can you stop the canary and set image to stable?

deploy-bot: rollback command executed: `kubectl set image statefulset/inference-runtime inference-runtime=redwood/inference:v2.11-stable` — rollout in progress. Canary traffic set to 0%.

jon_sre: monitoring shows pods coming up healthy on stable image with optimizations off. Error rate back to baseline.

incident-bot: PagerDuty updated: downgraded to P1. Mitigations applied: env disable optimizations, rollback to stable, node cordon. Monitoring 30m.

sophia_ml: follow-ups: add canary gating for kernel-level changes, add synthetic test that loads 20 models concurrently across multiple driver versions, and add runtime guards to detect pointer/address sanity before invoking optimized paths.

eli_runtime: follow-ups from runtime: revert fused-conv commit, add sanitizer builds (ASAN) for custom_kernels in CI, add a runtime-level mem-safety check and kill gracefully instead of segfaulting. I'll open PRs and link to incident.

nina_cs: prepared customer summary: mitigation applied, recovery observed, RCA and timeline for re-enable within 72 hours. Customers acknowledged.

maya_oncall: handing to day team: @eli_runtime and @jon_sre are owners for RCA and remediation. I'll stay reachable. Closing PD if stable for 30m. Thanks all. :pray:

infra_team: created maintenance ticket INF-5012 for gpu-ap-07/03 vendor inspection; we'll keep nodes cordoned until validated.

eli_runtime: uploaded debug notes and stack traces to the incident folder and will start bisecting commits between v2.11 and v2.12 canary; first suspect commit is e3b7f2.

maya_oncall: final status check: all inference-runtime pods Ready, crashloop count 0, error-rate normalized. Closing thread and posting RCA draft in #postmortems.

incident-bot: Closing note: incident mitigated; PD demoted to P1; postmortem pending.
